text: And Shephatiah{H8203} the son{H1121} of Mattan,{H4977} and Gedaliah{H1436} the son{H1121} of Pashhur,{H6583} and Jucal{H3116} the son{H1121} of Shelemiah,{H8018} and Pashhur{H6583} the son{H1121} of Malchijah,{H4441} heard{H8085} the words{H1697} that Jeremiah{H3414} spake{H1696} unto all the people,{H5971} saying,{H559}
